description: A React component for a user role dropdown in the admin console, allowing role management for users within teams or channels.

classes.name: UserGridRoleDropdown
classes.description: React component for managing user roles in a grid, with dropdown options for admin and member roles.

methods.name: getDropDownOptions
methods.description: Returns localized dropdown options based on scope (team or channel).

methods.name: getCurrentRole
methods.description: Determines the current role of the user based on membership and scope.

methods.name: getLocalizedRole
methods.description: Provides localized string for a given role.

methods.name: handleMakeAdmin
methods.description: Handles setting the user as an admin.

methods.name: handleMakeUser
methods.description: Handles setting the user as a regular member.

methods.name: getAriaLabel
methods.description: Provides ARIA label for accessibility based on scope.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the dropdown component with role options or shared indicator.
